question: Replace the highlighted segment: “You must adapt **with the situation**.”
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "adapt with" is incorrect in standard English usage.
 
• The correct preposition to use after "adapt" when referring to circumstances is "to."
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase is "adapt to the situation."
 
• Option 1 provides the grammatically correct replacement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You must adapt **to the situation**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "the situation"** – Missing the necessary preposition.
 
• **Option 3: "adapt to the situation"** – Repeats the verb unnecessarily.
 
• **Option 4: "by the situation"** – Incorrect preposition after "adapt."
